plan.title: fix(hooks): classify Cursor free-form ApplyPatch in parsePayload

narratives.Description: Normalize Cursor free-form ApplyPatch stdin in parsePayload so stock hook:dispatch does not fail-closed as parseFailed before tool-name inference.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/2738; locked decisions from issue body 2026-07-21.
narratives.Overview:
## Why

Free-form `*** Begin Patch` stdin never becomes JSON, so BOM-stripped parse still yields parseFailed. JSON ApplyPatch already works via inferCursorDirectWriteToolName.

## Locked decisions (issue body — do not reopen)

- **D1** In `packages/cli/src/hook-dispatch.ts` `parsePayload`: after BOM strip + failed JSON.parse, if stdin has `*** Begin Patch` and exactly one `Add File` or `Update File` path, synthesize `{ tool_name: "ApplyPatch", tool_input: { path, patch: post-BOM stdin } }` with empty context (not parseFailed).
- **D2** Multi-file / unparseable free-form / other garbage → keep parseFailed fail-closed.
- **D3** Regression tests in `hook-dispatch.test.ts` (+ dispatcher path as needed): free-form → ApplyPatch identity; multi-file deny; empty/invalid/BOM cases unchanged.
- **D4** CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`.
- **D5** Out of scope: Cursor parent ApplyPatch absence; project adapters; #2734 BOM rework; relaxing fail-closed for true garbage.

## Acceptance

- Free-form single-file ApplyPatch does not yield parseFailed / "not valid JSON"
- Synthesized payload recognized as ApplyPatch and reaches ritual/scope/allow like JSON today
- Multi-file + non-patch garbage still fail closed
- Tests + CHANGELOG; Closes #2738
